title: Public Services Budget: Parks, Library, Health
summary:
*   Austin officials held a work session to review proposed budget plans for the 2002-2003 fiscal year.
*   The session focused on community services, receiving detailed budget briefings for the Parks, Library, and Health departments.
*   Directors from these departments presented their financial needs and plans for essential public services.
*   Further budget discussions concerning Primary Care and Housing were scheduled for the following day's regular meeting.
transcript:
MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL WORKSESSION 
AUGUST 28,2002
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORKSESSION
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 28,2002
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they
occurred during the meeting. While the minutes are not in sequential order, all agenda
items were discussed.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, August 28,
2002 at One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, 3RD Floor Training Room, Austin,
Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 9:39 a.m.
Budget Briefings - Fiscal Year 2002-2003
1. 
Community Services: Parks, Library, Health, Primary Care and Housing.
The introduction was made by Michael McDonald, Assistant City Manager. The
individual department presentations were made as follows: Parks—Jesus Olivares,
Director; Library - Brenda Branch, Director; and Health and Human Service -
David Lurie, Director.
Primary Care and Housing briefings will be held on August 29, 2002 at the regular
Council Meeting starting at 10:00 a.m.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 11:54 a.m. was approved on Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman's motion, Council Member Dunkerley's second on a 7-0 vote.
The minutes from the work session of August 28, 2002 were approved on Council Member
Thomas' motion, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's second on a 7-0 vote.
